title: HTTP 403 Missing Scope
summary: Authenticated but not authorized for the action.
explain: 403 typically means the platform knows who you are but your token lacks required scopes/roles for the action. Fix role collections — do not confuse with 401 (not authenticated / token rejected).
analogy: You're in the building but your badge lacks the server-room flag.
whyItMatters: Wrong fix path wastes hours (password resets won't help).
mnemonic: KEYS ≠ BADGES: Admin keys open buildings; scopes/badges open rooms. Never master-key everyone.
